status: DECLARED AND CLOSED. No member may be added or removed.

why_a_shortlist_and_not_a_prescription.family_1: difference ratios; killed by OD-022 with a closed form and a 20000-draw sweep, mean 0.4997, fraction at or below zero 0.0000
why_a_shortlist_and_not_a_prescription.family_2: the rise in the donor answer's own log-probability; killed by the same mechanism mirrored, because destruction flattens the distribution and a_D is a low-probability token in the recipient's clean run
why_a_shortlist_and_not_a_prescription.the_lesson: intuition about which quantities are destruction-immune has now failed twice, so nothing is prescribed and everything is swept

C1_null_subtracted.idea: do not seek a functional form that is immune to destruction; measure destruction explicitly and subtract it
C1_null_subtracted.form: effect = raw(patched) - mean over replicates of raw(destructive patch at the same site and layer), where raw is any monotone response
C1_null_subtracted.why_it_might_survive: the subtrahend is measured under the same conditions as the minuend, so a common destructive component cancels rather than having to be argued away
C1_null_subtracted.known_risk_stated_in_advance: it is conservative in the direction that matters, but it inflates variance because the subtrahend is itself estimated

C2_matched_control_contrast.idea: deduct the flattening term using control tokens matched on clean probability
C2_matched_control_contrast.form: effect = (rise of a_D) - (mean rise of a set of control tokens whose clean probabilities match a_D's), at the readout position
C2_matched_control_contrast.why_it_might_survive: flattening lifts all low-probability tokens roughly alike, so a probability-matched control set absorbs the lift while a genuine transfer of the donor's answer does not lift the controls
C2_matched_control_contrast.known_risk_stated_in_advance: matching quality is finite, and a control set that is matched badly reintroduces the term it was meant to remove

C3_rank.idea: flattening lifts low-probability tokens roughly equally, which moves probabilities far more than it moves ORDER
C3_rank.form: effect = improvement in the rank of a_D in the full vocabulary, normalised so the donor's own clean run scores 1
C3_rank.why_it_might_survive: a uniform lift of the tail leaves relative order largely intact, so the destructive component should be much smaller in rank space than in probability space
C3_rank.known_risk_stated_in_advance: rank is invariant to scalar scaling, which is exactly the degeneracy EQ2 recorded for the J-lens readout; that is a reason to be careful in interpretation, not a reason to exclude it here

C4_two_sided_margin.seed_direction: competition, restricted to the two answers
C4_two_sided_margin.idea: compare the two answer tokens only, but as a share rather than a difference, so a common multiplicative depression cancels
C4_two_sided_margin.form: effect = p(a_D) / (p(a_D) + p(a_R)), rescaled so the recipient's clean run scores 0 and the donor's clean run scores 1
C4_two_sided_margin.why_it_might_survive: a destructive patch that depresses both answers by a common FACTOR leaves the share unchanged, whereas the difference of logits does not
C4_two_sided_margin.known_risk_stated_in_advance: destruction is not exactly multiplicative, so the cancellation is approximate and the sweep must decide

if_zero_survive: stop and report; adding a fifth after seeing which four failed would be selecting the instrument that decides the question
evaluation_order: every candidate faces the OD-022 clean-run destruction sweep first, because a candidate it rejects never needs anything further
survivors are then evaluated on the constructed object, where the intermediate is known
the winner is the largest margin over its own unrelated-donor null ceiling
every candidate's numbers are reported, including the eliminated ones
claim_ceiling: A declared shortlist. It licenses no claim of any kind.
